review_comments: Why are `new`-ing this?  I don't see the need for this redeclaration when `base.Masking` is public, and you're not doing anything more than calling `base`.
this is resharper enforced, for clarity when working with the class itself (sometimes you intentionally want to call `base.`).
My point was more why does the property exist at all.
`ModelBackedDrawable` is a composite, which doesn't expose masking itself. That said, you may have a point – could we not just set `Masking` via protected in all use cases? Seems saner to me.

~~`CompositeDrawable.Masking` is public.~~
Protected setter, I missed that.

~~actually, i think it would be better if i did the masking inside `BeatmapSetCover`~~

EDIT: the cover itself is a sprite so masking can be only applied at a higher level (`UpdateableBeatmapSetCover`)
